outcome: Prevalence of allergic disease in offspring
cohort: 175 mother-neonate pairs from Severance Hospital who were enrolled in the Cohort for Childhood Origin of Asthma and allergic diseases study
finding: Cesarean section, irrespective of the occurrence of labor before surgery, did not increase the prevalence of allergic disease in infants up to 3 years of age.
mod_finding: Cesarean section, whether planned or after labor, did not increase the prevalence of allergic disease in infants up to 3 years of age compared to vaginal delivery.
